text: Students who choose Chinese-teaching courses should study language program for 1-2 years to reach the level equivalent to HSK3, then they can start the clinical courses. Note: a. We’ll start the visa application procedure for the students, after getting their application fees. b. Students should pay all the fees for their first year’s study within one week after their arrival. c. Students have to pay separately for the Internet connection in their room: 30RMB/month. d. Students have to pay separately for the electricity and water used in their room: depends on usage.
